description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Owners: proposed package Storage.Runtime, Application and ConnectionWorker/transport generation integration. Provide an explicit package infrastructure child started by the host before preparation/seeding/listeners, configured by validated immutable init options. The child owns one shared storage manager per BEAM node; storage callbacks must not start infrastructure lazily. Expose bounded readiness for prepare/seed calls, returning a sanitized unavailable error if infrastructure is absent or tables are not ready. Separate process startup from table readiness, and reconcile unavailable tables with bounded retries. Reject duplicate starts and conflicting infrastructure options clearly. Manage only package tables; do not overwrite schema_location on an already running host or stop shared Mnesia on package shutdown. Detect Mnesia/table generation loss, fail closed during downtime, recreate/validate tables when ready, and invalidate affected listeners before protocol reuse. Preserve records across listener and manager restarts when tables remain valid. Keep unrelated non-Mnesia listeners running. Cover package stop/start, concurrent startup and start_runtime:false explicitly.

Tests to add before implementation:
Before code, add isolated-BEAM tests for RAM-only no-disk startup, existing disk-backed host coexistence and strict rejection, absent infrastructure no package tables or manager (independent of OTP dependency startup), concurrent/duplicate explicit starts, immutable configuration and invalid-option rejection before children start, table incompatibility, manager crash, Mnesia stop/start, table loss, repeated recovery, stale handle rejection, connection stop and host-supervised listener restart, unaffected other backend, and clean shutdown. Use synchronization/monitors, not sleeps; keep global Mnesia mutations outside shared test VM.

Branches/paths validated:
Explicit cold/warm start, configuration replacement and stale generation fencing before monitor delivery, already-running Mnesia, incompatible schema/table, timeout, storage-only and transport failures, old generation events, package stop, host infrastructure ownership.

Mocking plan:
Use real internal storage, transactions, supervision and host boundaries. Inject fake WhatsApp network transport only at external provider boundary; isolated BEAMs for VM-wide Mnesia state. Configuration resolved at public boundaries; ZAQ runtime config uses Zaq.Config per policy.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Package runtime/transport module docs, README and adapter_contracts lifecycle section.

Action reuse assessment:
Extend package-owned Application supervision and existing generation/health monitoring patterns; reuse GuardedStorage failure handling. Local-only OTP lifecycle, not workflow/agent operations. Host still owns listener restart policy. This step supplies regression evidence for zaq-0l7.22.

Validation and E2E:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md and docs/testing-approach.md; package follows its own quality gate. No new UI or user journey: no new E2E authoring required. Implementation must preserve existing assertions and include property tests for isolation/idempotence/capacity invariants.

web_widget-influenced refinement (user-authorized plan update):
Reference pattern (read-only inspection): ../web_widget/lib/web_widget.ex, lib/web_widget/supervisor.ex, lib/web_widget/configuration.ex, lib/web_widget/integration/binding_store.ex and docs/host-integration.md. Adopt explicit init options, package-owned tables, readiness distinct from process startup, immutable configuration generations, fail-closed operations and shutdown that leaves shared Mnesia intact. Do not copy JWT/reset-cutoff logic, replicated majority tables or cluster membership into WhatsApp.

Recovery contract: readiness and operation-generation checks protect access even before monitor notifications arrive. Restarting storage infrastructure must not erase surviving table contents; Mnesia/table generation loss must invalidate affected connections. Do not claim full Mnesia stop/start recovery merely from copying web_widget reconciliation: prove that lifecycle separately with isolated-BEAM failure tests.

Expanded upstream extraction scope (supersedes earlier references to retaining ZAQ Storage/Session): package owns temporary storage, pairing lifecycle, generic namespace routing/serialization and confirmation/handoff. ZAQ keeps only thin authorization/encrypted-persistence/connector callbacks in existing responsibility-compatible facades. All four modules under lib/zaq/channels/linked_device/ must be deleted; no equivalent state machine relocated elsewhere. Preserve this step's existing backend, lifecycle, rollout and validation requirements. New prerequisite issues cover the additional package and host API work.
